relation: definitional equality: every helper body is the body of seq_cyclic_consecutiveb c u v (boolean) or seq_cyclic_consecutive c u v (Prop), the pair (u, v) or (v, u) occurs in zip c (rot 1 c); the two forms are related by seq_cyclic_consecutiveP
summary: Batch B, family B4 (`consecutive_in_cycle`). Seven conjecture-local helpers now unfold to the cyclic adjacency of a raw sequence: `u` and `v` are adjacent in the cyclic order of `c`, in either order, i.e. `(u, v)` or `(v, u)` occurs in `zip c (rot 1 c)`. The five boolean helpers (XE1 chromatic, X9, X4, X27 and D2str's same-body cross-name adapter `cyc_edge`, an eta-expanded `rel G`) unfold to `GTBase.walks_paths.seq_cyclic_consecutiveb`, the two Prop helpers (X3, X91) to `seq_cyclic_consecutive`; `seq_cyclic_consecutiveP` reflects one into the other, so every helper is convertible to its canonical and both interfaces are kept. No path, edge, uniqueness, size or distinctness premise is added: the empty sequence relates nothing, a one-entry sequence relates its entry to itself (unlike B3's path relation), and two-entry and repeated sequences keep the closing pair.

Eighteen statements are affected: X3 (four rows) and cross-module X160 (chromatic), chromatic XE2 erdos:1091/erdos:842 through XE1's helper, X9, X4, extremal XE1 erdos:567 and XE2 erdos:767 through X4's helper, D2str's OPG geodesic-cycle row, X91, X27, and cross-module X42 and X220 (three rows). Every chain is frozen in one certificate per area, higher hole and cycle predicates with their own length guards (`3 < size c` in X3/X27, `3 <= size c` in X91) frozen as chains, not consolidated. D2str's `geodesic_cycle` is frozen inside a verbatim copy of its weighted Section; its unprefixed names are frozen as `d2str_*` copies. The helpers' proof consumers (`Minor.foundations.hole_containments`, D2str's grounding) only needed the extra unfold of the canonical; X220/X42 grounding and implications rebuild unchanged.

Historical snapshots: A1's `Minor.migration.induced_free.X42Legacy.statement` and B3's `GTMisc.migration.consecutive_in_path.X91Legacy.avoidable_path` call the live `x27_even_hole_free` and `x91_induced_cycle`; they are kept verbatim and documented below. `X42Original` (A1 + B4) and `X91Original` (B3 + B4) freeze those rows end to end over the earlier families' frozen objects (listed as `a1-frozen`/`b3-frozen` with their own certificates) and this family's chains. This family's own X42 and X91 snapshots keep the live A1/B3 helpers by design and are documented in the A1 and B3 specs as later-family snapshots.

History follow-up (private B4 + C5 baseline 45ab506): X3's rainbow-hole row also reaches family proper-colouring's (C5) `x3_proper_colouring`. This family's `X3Legacy` snapshot keeps that live, C5-migrated helper and C5's `X3Legacy` snapshot keeps the live `x3_rainbow_hole_run`; both stay verbatim and are documented. `X3Original.rainbow_consecutive_vertices_in_hole_statement` freezes the row end to end over C5's frozen `x3_proper_colouring` (listed as `c5-frozen`, with C5's certificate) and this family's frozen hole chain.

Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report: `Print All Dependencies` of the eighteen frozen statements and the two originals contains no live helper or chain declaration of this family and neither canonical, while each live statement reaches the canonical and its alias (/srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/B4-consecutive_in_cycle/print_all_dependencies_summary.txt, with the probe and the full output beside it); the Section scaffolding of D2str's frozen copy is checked verbatim beside it.

No statement text, doc block, manifest row or leg state changes (checked below), so the documented limitations stay verbatim, including erdos:1091's unbounded function, X4's five-tuple count, XE1's negative and positive chord clauses, XE2's strict bounds and truncated subtraction, X27/X42/X220 quantifier order and uniformity gaps, and the solved/open statuses.

Later migration: Cycle XE1 `xe1_cycle_edges`, listed here as a separate contract (a set of edges), was migrated by B11 (family cycle-edges) onto `GTBase.walks_paths.seq_cycle_graph_edge_set`, which reads its cyclic adjacency through this family's `seq_cyclic_consecutiveb`; it is no longer an untouched distinct variant.
